news.desc: Independence Day is a national holiday celebrated in many countries to mark the anniversary of their freedom or sovereignty from colonial rule or foreign control. The most prominent national celebrations include India's Independence Day on August 15 and the United States Independence Day (Fourth of July) on July 4.Major Independence DaysIndia (August 15): Commemorates the end of British rule in 1947 and the birth of a free nation, highlighted by the Prime Minister hoisting the flag at the Red Fort in Delhi.United States (July 4): Marks the adoption of the Declaration of Independence in 1776, celebrating with fireworks, parades, and family gatherings.Other Nations: Many countries observe their own distinct days, such as Pakistan on August 14, Mexico on September 16, and various other historical sovereignty dates globally.A short historical overview showing why India's Independence Day is celebrated at the Red Fort:6:51Why India's Independence Day Is Celebrated at Red Fort54K views · 9 days agoYouTube · DD IndiaIf you had a specific country or context in mind, please let me know which Independence Day you would like to explore.Encyclopedia BritannicaIndependence Day (4th of July) | History, Meaning, & Date - BritannicaIndependence Day (4th of July) | History, Meaning, & Date | Britannica. ...
